completeness_changes: Partial.hs synchronized to099 heterogeneous arbitrary-length prefix; empty/full prefix represented without an Int/binary cap.
CharacterRange generalized to Ord a; inclusive/reversed/unordered boundary contract explicit.
EvaluationModes generalized to Num a / Monad m and classified as semantic fixtures, not extra universal core operators.
StepIterator generalized to Monad m and arbitrary value/body-result types; terminal and body-failure behavior explicit; real whileJust_ used only in client.
Lazy checks owner ThreadId, rejects cross-owner access, detects recursive forcing, caches success, masks state transitions and resets on synchronous/asynchronous failure.
Shared LMX source dependencies linked once from their canonical full definitions instead of repeating large identical bodies in each comparison.
Lazy.hs also implements general onceIO; reviewed LMX busy guard/finally reset and prepared12 behavioral cases. Cleanup-registration hardening supplied to root separately.
async_scope: No new scheduler: reusable synchronous helpers execute in their owning Message; existing post transports asynchronous requests/replies, including the existing HTTP layer. No shared cross-Message cache, forceful interruption or extra cancellation guarantee is asserted.
